item.title: “You’re a vulture”: Tomi Lahren explodes at Candace Owens and warns Erika Kirk against giving conspiracies more oxygen
item.description: Conservative media's internal conflict erupted as Tomi Lahren publicly criticized Candace Owens, urging Charlie Kirk's widow to avoid a meeting. Lahren accused Owens of exploiting tragedy for profit and fueling outrage culture, warning against feeding a system that rewards extreme rhetoric. This incident highlights growing divisions over ethics and influence within right-wing media.
item.dc:creator: Barsha Dutta

item.title: “We had chemistry”: Nick Fuentes makes bold comment on Candace Owens as Charlie Kirk controversy grows
item.description: Far-right commentator Nick Fuentes reignited his public spat with Candace Owens, making surprising claims about her being in love with him. He also strongly criticized Owens' theories regarding Charlie Kirk's death, dismissing her 'visions' and 'dreams' as evidence. Fuentes expressed sympathy for Charlie Kirk's widow, Erika Kirk, while rejecting Owens' claims about the murder.
item.dc:creator: Sehjal Gupta

item.title: What really happened between Candace Owens and Erika Kirk? Full Charlie Kirk assassination controversy explained
item.description: A public fight has erupted between Candace Owens and Erika Kirk. This dispute centers on unproven rumors about Charlie Kirk. Owens questioned official accounts, while Kirk urged her to stop spreading hurtful falsehoods. The situation escalated with accusations of seeking attention. Both have expressed willingness to speak directly to resolve the matter.
item.dc:creator: Sehjal Gupta

item.title: Ted Cruz reacts as Candace Owens and Erika Kirk plan face to face meeting over Charlie Kirk killing
item.description: Senator Ted Cruz prayed for peace as Erika Kirk agreed to a direct discussion with Candace Owens. The meeting follows weeks of heated exchanges over Owens' theories about the death of Erika's husband, Charlie Kirk. Kirk has vehemently denied Owens' claims of a wider plot and involvement from Turning Point USA.
item.dc:creator: Sehjal Gupta

item.title: AugieRFC’s channel suspended by YouTube AI moderation, claims violation was fake
item.description: YouTube commentator AugieRFC faced a temporary channel shutdown due to a false child safety strike, suspected to be a glitch in YouTube's new AI moderation. This incident highlights a growing trend of erroneous penalties against creators, impacting livelihoods and raising concerns about automated enforcement without human oversight. Many creators are experiencing unfair strikes, leading to uncertainty.
item.dc:creator: Global Sports Desk

item.title: Ro Khanna, Pramila Jayapal and other Indian American leaders call for gun safety after Brown University shooting
item.description: Following a deadly shooting at Brown University that left two dead and eight injured, Indian American political leaders are demanding stronger gun safety measures. Representatives Khanna, Jayapal, and Krishnamoorthi highlighted the ongoing cost of inaction on gun violence legislation. The incident, occurring near the Sandy Hook anniversary, intensifies calls for reform.
item.dc:creator: TOI World Desk

item.title: MoistCr1TiKaL reviews The Game Awards 2025 while downplaying his own win
item.description: MoistCr1TiKaL's 10-minute analysis of The Game Awards 2025 is gaining traction, with Charlie focusing solely on the event's organization and management. Notably, he omits any mention of winning Creator of the Year, a decision fans find "classic Charlie." This analytical approach highlights his dedication to content and constructive criticism over self-promotion.

item.title: Surgeon who tried to save John Lennon describes the chilling moments before his death
item.description: A surgeon who tried to save John Lennon’s life has recalled the final moments after the Beatle was shot in 1980. Speaking years later, Dr Frank Veteran described the last sign of life, the frantic emergency surgery, and the personal toll of treating one of the most famous patients in history.
item.dc:creator: TOI Trending Desk

item.title: Florida doctor found dead in Dollar Tree freezer under mysterious circumstances
item.description: A Florida physician and mother of two was tragically found dead inside a Dollar Tree freezer in Miami. The 32-year-old, identified as Helen Massiell Garay Sanchez, entered the store before closing and accessed a restricted area. Authorities are investigating the unexplained circumstances surrounding her death, with no immediate evidence of foul play.
item.dc:creator: TOI World Desk

item.title: Mizkif leaves Twitch for Kick in dramatic Star Wars themed announcement
item.description: Popular streamer Mizkif has officially departed Twitch for Kick, announcing the move with a Star Wars-themed video. This transition follows serious allegations of abusive behavior from ex-girlfriend Emiru, which led to his removal from the organization OTK. Mizkif has since filed a defamation lawsuit. His future on Kick remains uncertain amidst ongoing controversy.
